goalbuddy_receipt_v1.rationale: User-facing claim: a human can author Type, Select, Drag, and Hold simply on the unified canvas while an agent uses the same durable operations, with native deterministic CSS and safe history. The shared service/compiler spine exists, but the claim fails materially: reusable authoring is dropdown/form-driven rather than canvas-first; Drag coordinates do not account for element origins; Hold discards source playback semantics; reduced motion and boundary proof are incomplete; and the Chrome receipt is nondeterministic and path-bearing. One corrective vertical slice is required before final QA.
evidence: Positive — all four semantics reach domain expansion, strict protocol parsing, service preparation, CLI creation, durable editor persistence, compilation, and installed Chrome. Independent focused rerun passed 9/9 domain and visual tests.

Positive — the preview test compares iframe srcdoc to compiledHtml and checks browser animation constructors; css-compiler and preview-runtime production sources are unchanged, so no second cue interpreter was added.

Positive — legacy cursor-path input and expansion digests are pinned in packages/domain/src/cue-authoring.test.ts:48-72; cue-owned direct edits still reject through the shared CUE_TRACK_LOCKED path; Drag detach preserves compiler HTML and Undo restores the attached cue in apps/editor/tests/phase4-reusable-cues.spec.ts:96-103.

Positive — independent git diff --check, sensitive scan, private-ignore scan, and protected-file diff all passed. The sensitive scan covered tracked, diff, index, worktree, and untracked content with findingCount=0; trackedPrivateCount=0.

P1 canvas failure — apps/editor/src/main.ts:1490-1492 explicitly hides the role step, hides cueTargetOverlay, and clears cuePathOverlay for the reusable workspace. Forms at lines 139-142 expose dropdowns and numeric geometry; the browser proof at apps/editor/tests/phase4-reusable-cues.spec.ts:54-68 authors every cue with selectOption. It never selects targets or shapes Drag on the canvas.

P1 Drag correctness failure — packages/domain/src/cue-authoring.ts:234-250 emits only transform tracks and treats stage coordinates as translate displacements. The fixture gives cursor and dragged objects different nonzero left/top origins at fixtures/public-synthetic/reusable-cues.html:11-14, so their rendered grip delta is not the stored grab offset. The visual test checks only that transform strings vary, not endpoint or grip geometry.

P1 Hold authority failure — packages/domain/src/cue-authoring.ts:151-164 hard-codes generated slots to iterationCount=1, direction=normal, fillMode=both, and playState=running; expandHold routes every source track through that helper at lines 370-392. A Hold over infinite, reverse/alternate, paused, or other fill-mode source motion changes behavior instead of preserving source semantics and shifting only later timing.

P1 Type target failure — reusableTargetOptions in apps/editor/src/main.ts:93-95 includes every element, and validation at packages/domain/src/cue-authoring.ts:317-320 checks timing only. A Type cue can therefore animate width on a non-text element, contrary to the existing-text contract; the browser test does not identify or assert a text target.

P1 reduced-motion failure — packages/local-service/src/seed.ts:58-63 reduces only the original .hold animation. Type, Select, and Drag remain animated, and no reusable-cue test runs with prefers-reduced-motion or asserts intentional output.

P1 proof failure — packages/visual-proof/src/reusable-cues.visual.test.ts:64 omits both sides of several Type step boundaries and parts of Drag press/move/release boundaries. Assertions at lines 65-70 require only more than two computed values plus one Hold equality; there are no exact expected frame hashes, pixel diffs, endpoint geometry checks, repeated frame hashes, or per-boundary aggregates.

P1 receipt failure — apps/editor/scripts/qa-chrome.mjs:80,98-102 emits wall-clock timestamps and a repository fixture path, making equal-input receipts byte-different and violating the path-free receipt contract. Lines 104-112 mostly record hard-coded assertion booleans and test-run text rather than canonical/compiler/export/proof digests, animation counts, diagnostics, or aggregate visual-diff results.

P2 Chrome diagnostics gap — apps/editor/tests/phase4-reusable-cues.spec.ts:38-39 collects page errors and failed requests only. It does not fail on console errors, HTTP errors, or unexpected network origins. Its native check at lines 73-76 is vacuously true for zero animations because no positive animation count is asserted.

P2 parity/history gap — CLI creation of all four cues is service-backed in packages/motion-cli/src/cli.test.ts:170-209, but the installed-Chrome workflow updates only Type with a human capability and detaches/undoes only Drag. It does not demonstrate agent claim authorization, rejected stale/unauthorized writes, or exact detach/delete/undo/redo for Hold, Type, and Select.
Failure mode 1, cue/track authority: failed because Hold changes source slot semantics; generic ownership and one Drag detach are insufficient.

Failure mode 2, editor/CLI durable parity: partial pass for create/reload and Type update, but failed as complete evidence because canvas authoring, agent claim use, and per-family history/rejection cases are absent.

Failure mode 3, native preview/proof/privacy: runtime boundary and repository privacy pass, but deterministic sanitized receipts, reduced motion, complete visual boundaries, spatial equivalence, and full Chrome diagnostics fail.
Phase containment passes: no five-scene closure, review/handoff, aggregate benchmark, landing implementation, MCP, Lineage, publication, or release work was added.

parallel_safety.reason: Corrections intersect the same cue generator, semantic validation, editor canvas state, durable browser workflow, and proof receipt. Splitting writers risks mismatched semantics and tests.

missing_evidence: True canvas target selection and direct Drag path/endpoint manipulation for all reusable roles.
Rendered Drag endpoint and constant-grip geometry against stage-normalized coordinates.
Hold preservation of iteration count, direction, fill mode, play state, timing function, delay, and unaffected source behavior.
Type rejection for non-text targets and proof that final reveal does not corrupt authored layout.
Intentional reduced-motion behavior for all four cue families.
Exact t-1/t/t+1 samples for every Type step and each Select, Drag, and Hold boundary, with repeated frame hashes or pixel-diff aggregates.
Path-free, copy-free, timestamp-free deterministic receipt containing canonical/compiler/export/proof digests, counts, diagnostics, and boundary aggregates.
Installed-Chrome console, page, HTTP, failed-request, unexpected-network, responsive, keyboard, positive-animation-count, agent-claim, and complete history evidence.
required_board_updates: Insert one corrective Worker task before T005; do not create a helper-only task or child board.

Corrective objective: make all four cues genuinely canvas-first and semantically faithful, preserve source playback behavior through Hold, make Drag rendered geometry match stored stage coordinates and grab offset, restrict Type to existing text, add intentional reduced motion, and replace weak proof/receipt assertions with exact deterministic evidence.

Corrective allowed_files: packages/domain/src/cue-authoring.ts; packages/domain/src/cue-authoring.test.ts; packages/domain/src/index.ts; packages/domain/src/index.test.ts; packages/motion-protocol/src/index.ts; packages/motion-protocol/src/index.test.ts; packages/motion-cli/src/cli.ts; packages/motion-cli/src/cli.test.ts; packages/local-service/src/seed.ts; apps/editor/src/main.ts; apps/editor/src/styles.css; apps/editor/src/global.d.ts; apps/editor/tests/phase4-reusable-cues.spec.ts; apps/editor/scripts/qa-chrome.mjs; fixtures/public-synthetic/reusable-cues.html; packages/visual-proof/src/reusable-cues.visual.test.ts; package.json.

Corrective verify: focused domain tests for metadata-preserving Hold, text-only Type, distinct role targets, exact Drag geometry, lock/rejection, detach/delete/undo/redo, and unchanged legacy digests; installed-Chrome canvas authoring with mouse and keyboard at wide/narrow viewports; agent CLI under an active claim; reload and stale/unauthorized atomic rejection; reduced-motion inspection; exact compiler srcdoc plus positive CSSAnimation inventory; complete console/page/HTTP/network checks; every boundary t-1/t/t+1 with repeated visual hashes/diffs; deterministic receipt equality; then all public commands recorded by T006 plus privacy/protected-file checks.

Corrective stop_if: fixing Drag requires ambient layout lookup during expansion instead of explicit versioned target state or deterministic zero-origin tracks; Hold cannot preserve every source slot field; existing cursor/click/reveal bytes or IDs change; a second runtime/interpolator is proposed; private material or later-phase scope is required; or files outside the corrective allowlist are needed.
After correction, rerun T004 adversarial review before activating T005.
